COMPONENT_SET.finding: The required AOC-275.18 primary filing is present in canonical and boundary fixtures. Required service instructions are in participant-facing guidance, and the conditional court-order treatment is explicitly process guidance/reference only. No missing generated instrument is silently promised.

KNOWN_PREFILLS.finding: Canonical contains six fitting prefills: case number, county, respondent first/middle/last name and full movant name. Boundary contains five fitting prefills, including the real Breckinridge county option and the full composed long name. Its long case number is refused at widget width and remains blank for manual completion, with no truncation or substitution. The prior boundary name omission is corrected.

REQUIRED_BEFORE_FILING.finding: Division, Court and all three Petitioner name fields are classified REQUIRED_BEFORE_FILING and handed to the participant to copy from the case papers. The three sworn allegations remain genuine participant elections. Date, signature and address/telephone remain participant-owned printed lines; the notification/hearing block remains clerk-owned. Classified blanks are disclosed rather than treated as complete.

ROUTE_OPTIONS.finding: No sworn box is auto-checked; the participant is told to check each only if true. No unsupported relief election is invented. Franklin and Breckinridge are delivered as actual county choices, and no delivered choice value is outside the form's own options.

REPEATING_ROWS.finding: AOC-275.18 is a one-page motion with no repeating data table. No partial row or unbounded repetition is introduced.

PROTECTED_FIELDS.finding: Court, clerk and participant-owned execution fields remain blank where required. The sworn boxes, petitioner fields, Division and Court, clerk notification block and printed signature/date/address lines are not falsely completed. Print and Reset controls are suppressed; no service certificate or universal affidavit is written.

ARTIFACTS.finding: Current canonical and boundary PDFs are byte-stable, one page each, and retain the AOC-275.18 source pairing. Saved reports record no active-content hits, no invalid delivered choice values and zero non-whitespace glyphs outside measured write boxes. These are byte-level results, not raster measurement.

PAGE_ORDER.finding: Both fixtures map packet page 1 to source page 1 of AOC-275.18 with the exact source hash. No page is dropped, added or reordered.

CLIPPING_AND_OVERLAP.finding: Direct review of both custody-verified original PNG pages found no clipping, overlap, missing ink, crop, unintended blank page or unauthorized protected-field ink. Canonical case number/county and respondent/movant values fit; boundary Breckinridge county and the long respondent name segments remain legible. Court, Division, petitioner, sworn boxes, signature/date/address/telephone, clerk notification/hearing and Copies fields remain blank or unselected where participant or clerk completion is required.
CLIPPING_AND_OVERLAP.method: Original retained page PNGs were opened with view_image at original detail after their exact SHA-256, byte-length, dimension and PNG-signature comparison to the custody page inventory. No raster was generated, downloaded, copied, edited or rerendered.

FILING_DESTINATION.finding: Guidance directs filing in the protective-order case with the Office of the Circuit Court Clerk for the court where the petition was heard, with case number, county, court and division copied from the case papers. Clerk-owned signature, filed stamp, notification and scheduling steps are identified without pretending they are participant-completed.

FEE_AND_WAIVER.finding: The filing guidance carries the recorded treatment that no filing fee was identified and that a fee waiver is not applicable because no fee was identified. It invents no amount, waiver form or payment assertion and tells the participant to ask the clerk. The prior false absence claim is corrected; the missing manual limits fresh external fee-source revalidation.

SERVICE.finding: The guidance distinguishes both actual pathways: the movant may serve copies by first-class mail, or the clerk serves when the movant has not already done so. It preserves applicable CR 5.03 proof options and timing, requires documentation to describe acts by the actual server, and tells the participant not to certify clerk acts. The AOC notification section and Copies to list are notice/distribution controls, not proof. No unconditional certificate, universal affidavit or proof waiver is promised. The boundary case-number refusal is manual completion and does not alter the service rule or invent a county/case value.

SELF_HELP_STOP.finding: The guide carries the route limitations and four stop conditions: a full domestic-violence or non-temporary order, a protective-order history against the participant in the preceding six months, a related criminal record the participant wants cleared, and a disputed good-cause or other contested matter. It directs individualized help rather than implying unsupported eligibility.
